note: Generated by workflow/build.mjs from the workflow JSON: every node with its section, canvas position and the note shown under it, and every connection (kind error = the node's error output).

sections.name: 1. Intake and trust
sections.text: Signature first (401), then the shape (400 and a dead letter), then one ledger claim per event id (409 in flight, 200 duplicate).

sections.name: 2. Check and number
sections.text: Business checks before any number is taken (422 on refusal). Then 202, and a gap-free number from the data service sequence. A replay reuses the invoice it already made.

sections.name: 3. Render, store and send
sections.text: One PDF per invoice at a fixed storage key, checked by SHA-256 on the way in and out; one email per event, keyed, its start stamped first. Each step is recorded on the invoice, so a replay resumes where the last run stopped.

sections.name: 4. Void and refund
sections.text: Only valid transitions: void while nothing is paid, refund up to what was paid. Each write is guarded by the invoice money_seq; a run that loses reads again and decides again. Answered at once.

sections.name: 5. Finish
sections.text: Ledger done with the outcome; a summary item with ids only.

nodes.name: Receive billing event
nodes.note: POST /webhook/crit/invoices/billing-events. Signed by the sender with BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET; the raw body is kept for the HMAC.

nodes.name: Verify signature
nodes.note: HMAC-SHA256 over "<t>.<raw body>" from X-CRIT-Signature, constant-time compare, then the timestamp within 300 s. Nothing runs before this.

nodes.name: Route on signature
nodes.note: Early exit: a missing, wrong or stale signature ends the run with 401 and no call of any kind.

nodes.name: Respond 401 unauthorized
nodes.note: Answers 401 {status: unauthorized, error}.

nodes.name: Validate event shape
nodes.note: Envelope (id, type, created_at, data) and the data of invoice.requested, invoice.void_requested and refund.requested, checked before anything is stored. Amounts must be whole minor units.

nodes.name: Route by event shape
nodes.note: valid goes on; a well-formed event of another type is ignored; a broken one is dead-lettered.

nodes.name: Respond 200 ignored
nodes.note: Answers 200 {status: ignored}. Nothing stored.

nodes.name: Store dead letter
nodes.note: Data service dead_letters: the payload as received, the reasons, its hash (unique, so a second delivery is not stored twice). Non-critical.

nodes.name: Respond 400 invalid
nodes.note: Answers 400 {status: invalid, errors, dead_letter_id}.

nodes.name: Check dead letter stored
nodes.note: After the 400: if the dead letter was not stored, the run fails into the error workflow, which alerts with the payload hash (ids only). The payload stays in the failed execution.

nodes.name: Prepare event claim
nodes.note: Ledger claim for this billing event (scope billing_event, key = the sender's event id), with the event kept for replay.

nodes.name: Claim event
nodes.note: Data service ledger: one claim per event id. Critical: 3 retries 5 s apart, then the error workflow.

nodes.name: Read claim result
nodes.note: claimed goes on; in_flight means another run holds it; done means it was handled already.

nodes.name: Route on claim
nodes.note: Early exit for in_flight (409, the sender retries later) and done (200 duplicate).

nodes.name: Respond 409 in flight
nodes.note: Answers 409 with Retry-After: 30. Nothing else runs.

nodes.name: Respond 200 duplicate
nodes.note: Answers 200 {status: duplicate, outcome} with the first run's outcome. Nothing else runs.

nodes.name: Route by event type
nodes.note: invoice.requested goes to numbering and delivery; void and refund requests to section 4.

nodes.name: Fetch billing config
nodes.note: Data service config "invoice-to-payment": seller, currencies, tax rates, number format, limits.

nodes.name: Find client
nodes.note: Data service clients: the client named in the request (status, billing currency, email for delivery).

nodes.name: Find invoice for event
nodes.note: Data service invoices by request_event_id: an invoice already made for this event means a replay; it is reused.

nodes.name: Decide invoice plan
nodes.note: Client active, currency configured and the client's, due date not before issue date, totals and tax in integer minor units. A refusal takes no number.

nodes.name: Route invoice plan
nodes.note: accept or reject.

nodes.name: Respond 422 rejected
nodes.note: Answers 422 {status: rejected, reasons}. No number is taken; the ledger records the refusal.

nodes.name: Respond 202 accepted
nodes.note: Answers the sender now (202) so it does not redeliver while the PDF is made and sent; the run continues.

nodes.name: Route on existing invoice
nodes.note: A replay that already has its invoice row skips numbering.

nodes.name: Claim invoice number
nodes.note: Data service sequence invoice-<year>: one value per event id, max + 1, gap-free. The same event always gets the same number back.

nodes.name: Prepare invoice row
nodes.note: CRIT-<year>-<0000> and the invoice row from the event, the config and the number only, so a replay sends the same bytes.

nodes.name: Store invoice row
nodes.note: Data service invoices (unique request_event_id and number), status issued. Idempotency-Key per event and node. Critical.

nodes.name: Read stored invoice
nodes.note: Keeps the stored invoice for delivery.

nodes.name: Check delivery progress
nodes.note: From the stored invoice: render (nothing yet), email (PDF stored, not sent), finish (already sent, or voided meanwhile). An email started more than 23 hours ago with no answer recorded stops the run (no second email).

nodes.name: Route delivery step
nodes.note: render, email or finish.

nodes.name: Create invoice PDF
nodes.note: Document rendering service: the CRIT HTML template in, PDF bytes out. Read-only. 3 retries 5 s apart.

nodes.name: Hash invoice PDF
nodes.note: Checks the %PDF signature and size limit, SHA-256 of the bytes. The bytes go on as binary, never into a row.

nodes.name: Store invoice PDF
nodes.note: Object storage PUT at a fixed key per invoice (invoices/<year>/<number>.pdf): a repeat overwrites the same object, never a second one.

nodes.name: Prepare PDF record
nodes.note: Storage must confirm the same SHA-256; then the update that records the key and hash on the invoice.

nodes.name: Record PDF on invoice
nodes.note: Data service update on the invoice: pdf_key, pdf_sha256, pdf_bytes, only while no PDF is recorded.

nodes.name: Download stored PDF
nodes.note: Reads the stored object back, so the email attaches exactly what storage holds.

nodes.name: Prepare invoice email
nodes.note: Checks the downloaded bytes against the recorded SHA-256, then the Resend-shaped email with the PDF attached.

nodes.name: Record email start
nodes.note: Data service update on the invoice: stamps email_started_at with the service clock (kept from the first attempt) before the send, so a late replay knows an email may be out.

nodes.name: Send invoice email
nodes.note: Transactional email API POST /emails with Idempotency-Key per event: a retry after a timeout gets the first answer, not a second email.

nodes.name: Prepare delivery record
nodes.note: The email id, and the update issued -> sent.

nodes.name: Record delivery
nodes.note: Data service update on the invoice: status sent and email_id, only from issued.

nodes.name: Prepare delivered result
nodes.note: The ledger result: invoice id, number, total, email id, PDF hash. No client data.

nodes.name: Find invoice to change
nodes.note: Data service invoices by the invoice number in the request, read first: its money_seq guards the write. Read again after a guard conflict.

nodes.name: Find invoice payments
nodes.note: Data service payments recorded for that invoice number.

nodes.name: Find invoice refunds
nodes.note: Data service refunds already made on that invoice.

nodes.name: Decide change
nodes.note: Void: only issued or sent with nothing paid. Refund: only up to paid minus refunded, same currency, not on a void invoice. A replay of the same event goes on from its stored state. At most 5 passes.

nodes.name: Route change decision
nodes.note: void, refund, void_replay, refund_resume, refund_replay, not_found, invalid_transition or refund_refused.

nodes.name: Mark invoice void
nodes.note: Data service update: status void, only from issued or sent and only while money_seq is the one read (guard). Idempotency-Key per event and money_seq.

nodes.name: Route on void write
nodes.note: changed goes on; a guard conflict (a payment or refund landed first) reads the invoice again and decides again.

nodes.name: Prepare void result
nodes.note: Checks the invoice is now void and builds the answer.

nodes.name: Respond 200 voided
nodes.note: Answers 200 {status: voided}.

nodes.name: Store refund row
nodes.note: Data service refunds (unique event id), status approved, only while the invoice money_seq is the one read (guard). Idempotency-Key per event and money_seq.

nodes.name: Route on refund write
nodes.note: stored goes on to the processor; a guard conflict (another refund, payment or void landed first) reads again and decides again.

nodes.name: Prepare processor refund
nodes.note: The refund request for the payment processor: reference, amount, currency, refund id. Only after the refund row won.

nodes.name: Send refund to processor
nodes.note: Payment processor POST /v1/refunds with Idempotency-Key per event: a retry never refunds twice.

nodes.name: Prepare refund record
nodes.note: The processor's refund id and the update approved -> submitted.

nodes.name: Record processor refund
nodes.note: Data service update on the refund: status submitted, processor_refund_id.

nodes.name: Prepare refund result
nodes.note: The answer and the ledger result: refund id, processor id, amount.

nodes.name: Respond 200 refunded
nodes.note: Answers 200 {status: refunded, refund_id, processor_refund_id}.

nodes.name: Respond 404 unknown invoice
nodes.note: Answers 404 {status: unknown_invoice}.

nodes.name: Respond 409 invalid transition
nodes.note: Answers 409 {status: invalid_transition, from, to}: for example a paid invoice cannot be voided.

nodes.name: Respond 422 refund refused
nodes.note: Answers 422 {status: refund_refused, reason}: more than was paid, or another currency.

nodes.name: Mark event done
nodes.note: Data service ledger: this event is done with its outcome, so a redelivery answers duplicate. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Summarize run
nodes.note: The run's final item: event, outcome, invoice id and number. No client data.

sections.name: 1. Intake and trust
sections.text: Signature first (401), then the shape (400 and a dead letter), then one ledger claim per event id (409 in flight, 200 duplicate). Claimed: 202 now.

sections.name: 2. Match and record
sections.text: Invoice by reference, the payments and refunds before this one, one decision, stored with the payment only while the invoice money_seq is unchanged; a run that loses reads again and decides again. A replay reads its own row back.

sections.name: 3. Receipt
sections.text: Only when this payment completes the invoice. One receipt per event, keyed; recorded on the invoice.

sections.name: 4. Review
sections.text: Anything ambiguous: a review item and an alert with ids and amounts.

sections.name: 5. Finish
sections.text: Ledger done with the outcome; a summary item with ids only.

nodes.name: Receive payment event
nodes.note: POST /webhook/crit/invoices/payment-events. Signed by the sender with PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET; the raw body is kept for the HMAC.

nodes.name: Verify signature
nodes.note: HMAC-SHA256 over "<t>.<raw body>" from X-CRIT-Signature, constant-time compare, then the timestamp within 300 s. Nothing runs before this.

nodes.name: Route on signature
nodes.note: Early exit: a missing, wrong or stale signature ends the run with 401 and no call of any kind.

nodes.name: Respond 401 unauthorized
nodes.note: Answers 401 {status: unauthorized, error}.

nodes.name: Validate event shape
nodes.note: Envelope (id, type, created_at, data) and the data of payment.received, checked before anything is stored. Amounts must be whole minor units.

nodes.name: Route by event shape
nodes.note: valid goes on; a well-formed event of another type is ignored; a broken one is dead-lettered.

nodes.name: Respond 200 ignored
nodes.note: Answers 200 {status: ignored}. Nothing stored.

nodes.name: Store dead letter
nodes.note: Data service dead_letters: the payload as received, the reasons, its hash (unique, so a second delivery is not stored twice). Non-critical.

nodes.name: Respond 400 invalid
nodes.note: Answers 400 {status: invalid, errors, dead_letter_id}.

nodes.name: Check dead letter stored
nodes.note: After the 400: if the dead letter was not stored, the run fails into the error workflow, which alerts with the payload hash (ids only). The payload stays in the failed execution.

nodes.name: Prepare event claim
nodes.note: Ledger claim for this payment event (scope payment_event, key = the sender's event id), with the event kept for replay.

nodes.name: Claim event
nodes.note: Data service ledger: one claim per event id. Critical: 3 retries 5 s apart, then the error workflow.

nodes.name: Read claim result
nodes.note: claimed goes on; in_flight means another run holds it; done means it was handled already.

nodes.name: Route on claim
nodes.note: Early exit for in_flight (409, the sender retries later) and done (200 duplicate).

nodes.name: Respond 409 in flight
nodes.note: Answers 409 with Retry-After: 30. Nothing else runs.

nodes.name: Respond 200 duplicate
nodes.note: Answers 200 {status: duplicate, outcome} with the first run's outcome. Nothing else runs.

nodes.name: Respond 202 accepted
nodes.note: Answers the processor now (202) so it does not redeliver while the payment is matched; the run continues.

nodes.name: Fetch billing config
nodes.note: Data service config "invoice-to-payment": currencies for the amounts in the review text.

nodes.name: Find invoice by reference
nodes.note: Data service invoices whose number is the payment reference, read first: its money_seq guards the write. Read again after a guard conflict.

nodes.name: Find payments for reference
nodes.note: Data service payments already recorded with this reference: the state before this one, and this event's own row on a replay.

nodes.name: Find refunds for invoice
nodes.note: Data service refunds on that invoice (a payment after a refund is a review).

nodes.name: Decide payment match
nodes.note: exact, partial, completes, overpaid, already_paid, wrong_currency, unknown_reference, invoice_void or after_refund, from the rows before this payment. A replay reads the decision back from its own row; the same processor payment under a new event id is a duplicate. At most 5 passes.

nodes.name: Route payment match
nodes.note: record, replay (its row is already stored: go on from it), or duplicate (nothing stored).

nodes.name: Store payment row
nodes.note: Data service payments (unique event id and processor payment id) with the decision, only while the invoice money_seq is the one read (guard). Idempotency-Key per event and money_seq. Critical.

nodes.name: Route on payment write
nodes.note: stored goes on; a guard conflict (another payment, a refund or a void landed first) reads the invoice again and decides again.

nodes.name: Read payment row
nodes.note: Keeps the stored payment (or, on a replay, the row found); receipt and review flags from the decision.

nodes.name: Route on receipt
nodes.note: A receipt goes out when this payment brings the invoice to paid in full (exact, completes, overpaid).

nodes.name: Find client for receipt
nodes.note: Data service clients: the invoice's client, for the receipt address.

nodes.name: Prepare receipt email
nodes.note: The Resend-shaped receipt: amount, date, reference, invoice number. A replay more than 23 hours after the payment row was stored stops the run instead (no second receipt).

nodes.name: Send receipt email
nodes.note: Transactional email API POST /emails with Idempotency-Key per event: one receipt per payment event, also after a timeout.

nodes.name: Prepare receipt record
nodes.note: The receipt email id and the update that records it on the invoice.

nodes.name: Record receipt on invoice
nodes.note: Data service update on the invoice: receipt_email_id and paid_at, only while no receipt is recorded.

nodes.name: Check receipt recorded
nodes.note: Checks the update answered with the invoice.

nodes.name: Route on review
nodes.note: Over-payments, wrong currency, unknown reference, void invoice and payment after refund go to review. Nothing is guessed.

nodes.name: Prepare review item
nodes.note: The review row: kind, ids and amounts. No client name, email or line text.

nodes.name: Store review item
nodes.note: Data service review_items (unique per event and kind). Idempotency-Key per event and node.

nodes.name: Prepare review alert
nodes.note: Slack text for the billing review channel: ids and amounts only.

nodes.name: Post review alert
nodes.note: chat.postMessage to REVIEW_SLACK_CHANNEL. Non-critical: a failed alert is noted, the review item is already stored.

nodes.name: Check review alert
nodes.note: Notes whether the alert went out.

nodes.name: Prepare done mark
nodes.note: The ledger result: payment id, invoice id, match, receipt and review ids.

nodes.name: Mark event done
nodes.note: Data service ledger: this event is done with its outcome, so a redelivery answers duplicate. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Summarize run
nodes.note: The run's final item: event, match, ids. No client data.

sections.name: 1. Start and clock
sections.text: Two schedules and a signed sweep request (401, 400, 202). The clock is fixed once per run.

sections.name: 2. Reminders
sections.text: Overdue, open, step reached and not sent: one claim, one email, one row per step. Early exits when nothing is overdue or due.

sections.name: 3. Watchdog
sections.text: Stuck invoices and orphan numbers, each reported once. Early exit when nothing is stuck or new.

nodes.name: Receive daily reminder tick
nodes.note: Schedule: every day at 09:00 in the workflow time zone (Asia/Manila).

nodes.name: Prepare reminder sweep
nodes.note: A reminders sweep with the real clock. INVOICE_SCHEDULES=off stops it here (the tests start sweeps by request instead).

nodes.name: Receive watchdog tick
nodes.note: Schedule: every hour at minute 20.

nodes.name: Prepare watchdog sweep
nodes.note: A watchdog sweep with the real clock. INVOICE_SCHEDULES=off stops it here.

nodes.name: Receive sweep request
nodes.note: POST /webhook/crit/invoices/sweeps: an operator or a test starts a sweep. Signed with BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Verify signature
nodes.note: Same check as the billing intake: HMAC over the raw body, then the timestamp within 300 s.

nodes.name: Route on signature
nodes.note: Early exit: 401 and no call.

nodes.name: Respond 401 unauthorized
nodes.note: Answers 401 {status: unauthorized, error}.

nodes.name: Validate sweep request
nodes.note: sweep.reminders or sweep.watchdog, optional data.as_of (used only when INVOICE_CLOCK_OVERRIDE is allow).

nodes.name: Route sweep request
nodes.note: valid goes on, anything else gets 400.

nodes.name: Respond 400 invalid
nodes.note: Answers 400 {status: invalid, errors}.

nodes.name: Respond 202 accepted
nodes.note: Answers 202 {status: accepted, kind}; the sweep runs after the answer.

nodes.name: Fetch chase config
nodes.note: Data service config "invoice-to-payment": reminder steps, stuck threshold, time zone.

nodes.name: Read chase config
nodes.note: Fixes the clock for this run (now, or as_of when allowed) and the date in the business time zone.

nodes.name: Route by sweep kind
nodes.note: reminders or watchdog.

nodes.name: Find sent invoices
nodes.note: Data service invoices with status sent (delivered, not void).

nodes.name: Pick overdue invoices
nodes.note: Due date before today. None: early exit, nothing else is read.

nodes.name: Route on overdue
nodes.note: Early exit when no delivered invoice is past due.

nodes.name: Find payments
nodes.note: Data service payments, to derive what is still open on each invoice.

nodes.name: Find refunds
nodes.note: Data service refunds: a refunded invoice is not chased.

nodes.name: Find sent reminders
nodes.note: Data service reminders already sent (one row per invoice and step).

nodes.name: Find clients
nodes.note: Data service clients, for the reminder address.

nodes.name: Decide reminders due
nodes.note: Per invoice: the highest step reached (config reminder_steps_days), only if neither it nor a later step was sent. Paid and refunded invoices get nothing. One item per reminder.

nodes.name: Route on planned
nodes.note: Early exit when nothing is due.

nodes.name: Claim reminder steps
nodes.note: Data service ledger, one claim per invoice and step (scope invoice_reminder): a step is sent at most once, also when two sweeps overlap.

nodes.name: Pick claimed steps
nodes.note: claimed goes to send; a claim taken over from a failed or stuck run goes to review (the email may have gone out); in flight or done is skipped.

nodes.name: Route reminder claim
nodes.note: send, review or none.

nodes.name: Send reminder emails
nodes.note: Transactional email API POST /emails, one per item, Idempotency-Key per invoice and step. Critical.

nodes.name: Prepare reminder rows
nodes.note: The reminder row per sent email: step, days overdue, open amount, email id.

nodes.name: Store reminder rows
nodes.note: Data service reminders (unique invoice and step). Idempotency-Key per invoice, step and node.

nodes.name: Prepare reminder done marks
nodes.note: Ledger done marks for the sent steps.

nodes.name: Store reminder reviews
nodes.note: Data service review_items: the step whose state is unknown, ids and amounts only.

nodes.name: Prepare review alert
nodes.note: One Slack message for the billing review channel listing the steps under review.

nodes.name: Post review alert
nodes.note: chat.postMessage to REVIEW_SLACK_CHANNEL. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Prepare review done marks
nodes.note: Ledger done marks (needs_review) for the steps under review, so they are not claimed again.

nodes.name: Mark reminder steps done
nodes.note: Data service ledger: each step done with its outcome. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Summarize reminders
nodes.note: The run's final item: date, clock source, what was sent or skipped and why. Ids only.

nodes.name: Find all invoices
nodes.note: Data service invoices, all statuses.

nodes.name: Find taken numbers
nodes.note: Data service invoice_numbers: every number taken from the sequence.

nodes.name: Find stuck work
nodes.note: Invoices still issued (not delivered) and numbers with no invoice row, older than stuck_after_minutes. None: early exit.

nodes.name: Route on stuck
nodes.note: Early exit when nothing is stuck.

nodes.name: Claim stuck reports
nodes.note: Data service ledger, one claim per stuck invoice or number (scope stuck_report): each is reported once.

nodes.name: Pick new reports
nodes.note: Keeps the newly claimed ones and builds one alert. None new: early exit.

nodes.name: Route on new reports
nodes.note: Early exit when everything stuck was reported before.

nodes.name: Post watchdog alert
nodes.note: chat.postMessage to REVIEW_SLACK_CHANNEL: invoice ids, numbers and ages. Critical: if it fails, the claims are released and the next run reports again.

nodes.name: Prepare report done marks
nodes.note: Ledger done marks for the reported items.

nodes.name: Mark reports done
nodes.note: Data service ledger: each report done. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Summarize watchdog
nodes.note: The run's final item: what was found and reported. Ids only.
